title: Decision-Native Recommendation with Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.34124v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) bring world knowledge to user preference modeling in sequential recommendation, but generation-based recommenders express next-item predictions indirectly as text. Generated outputs may fail to identify a unique candidate item, depend on candidate presentation order in the prompt, and lack explicit confidence in the recommendation. Recent studies explore Jev, a model for fast option selection with explicit confidence. Inspired by Jev, we introduce decision-native recommendation, a new paradigm that jointly models item choice and recommendation confidence using LLM representations. It requires valid candidate selection, consistency under candidate reordering, and confidence that reflects recommendation accuracy. We propose Direct Item Choice Estimation (DICE), which learns a personalized next-item distribution over supplied candidates from user interaction history and recommends the highest-scoring item with c

translated_title: 基于大语言模型的决策原生推荐
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）为序列推荐中的用户偏好建模带来了世界知识，但基于生成的推荐器以文本形式间接表达下一物品预测。生成的输出可能无法唯一确定一个候选物品，依赖于提示中候选物品的呈现顺序，并且缺乏对推荐的显式置信度。近期研究探索了Jev，一个具有显式置信度的快速选项选择模型。受Jev启发，我们提出了决策原生推荐，这是一种利用LLM表示联合建模物品选择和推荐置信度的新范式。该范式要求有效的候选物品选择、在候选顺序重排下的一致性，以及能够反映推荐准确性的置信度。我们提出了直接物品选择估计（DICE），它从用户交互历史中学习在给定候选物品集合上的个性化下一物品分布，并推荐得分最高的物品…
tldr: 该论文提出了“决策原生推荐”新范式及DICE方法，利用大语言模型表示直接在候选物品上进行选择估计并同时输出显式推荐置信度，解决了生成式推荐无法唯一确定物品、受候选顺序影响且缺乏置信度的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces decision-native recommendation, a new paradigm with the DICE (Direct Item Choice Estimation) method that uses LLM representations to directly model item choice and explicit recommendation confidence over candidate items, addressing the limitations of generation-based recommenders such as ambiguous outputs, order sensitivity, and lack of confidence.
